takes.h: Stephen Graham Jones's Off the Reservation lands October 13
takes.p: Stephen Graham Jones's Off the Reservation arrives from Saga Press in hardcover on Tuesday, October 13. Activists retrieve the bones of a Blackfeet boy who died at the Carlisle Indian Industrial School, and something dangerous comes back with them. Nate Yellow Tail, who survived The Only Good Indians, is the protagonist.

Subterranean Press posted on September 28 that its signed limited edition of Tananarive Due's The Reformatory is in stock and ready to ship. Availability can change, so check the page before ordering.

takes.h: Flanagan on Martyrs: the scariest film he has made
takes.p: At Blumhouse's New York Comic Con panel, Mike Flanagan said The Exorcist: Martyrs is the scariest film he has made, Dread Central reports. Universal's release date for the film is March 12, 2027.

takes.h: NECA's Ultimate Savini Jason, Friday the 13th: The Game
takes.p: NECA's Ultimate Savini Jason, based on Friday the 13th: The Game, comes with interchangeable heads including light-piped eyes, extra hands, a demonic hockey mask, a smoke piece and the Devil's Pitchfork. Bleeding Cool reported the figure in June with a July 2026 release.
